_comment: Rows 247/248. The band executes a real tsc/Vite build against a nonzero deployed-dist fixture while also snapshotting the checkout's real frontend/dist whether present or absent. M1/M2 move one command back to the repository frontend and are caught by the exact two-call ownership evidence. M3 copies deploy output into the supposedly fresh input and is caught by the copy-shape gate. M4 reproduces the filed destructive behavior against the owned deployed fixture: Vite empties source/dist, the marker disappears, and the byte-manifest assertion fails with removed=['.bd-built-from']. The matching transform-only spec points M4 at an import-only nodeid and must ESCAPE.
subject: Rows 247/248 -- build_manifest owns its copied frontend and output, preserving deployed fixture bytes and the checkout frontend/dist state

mutants.label: M1 tsc runs in the real repository frontend instead of the owned copy
M2 Vite runs in the real repository frontend instead of the owned copy
M3 frontend/dist is copied into the build input instead of excluded
M4 FILED DEFECT Vite empties source/dist and deletes .bd-built-from
mutants.old:
dist = workspace / "dist"
        assert not dist.exists(), f"owned build output already exists: {dist}"
mutants.new:
dist = source / "dist"
        assert dist.exists(), f"deployed fixture output is missing: {dist}"
